query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T10:25:06Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T10:55:06Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (
            (process.name == "sshd" AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL)
            OR (message LIKE "*session opened*" OR message LIKE "*session closed*")
        )
| EVAL event_type = CASE(message LIKE "*Accepted*", "auth_accepted", message LIKE "*Failed password*", "auth_failed", message LIKE "*session opened*", "session_opened", message LIKE "*session closed*", "session_closed", "other")
| EVAL auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey", message LIKE "*password*", "password", message LIKE "*certificate*", "certificate", "unknown")
| KEEP @timestamp, message, source.ip, user.name, event.outcome, event_type, auth_method, host.name
| SORT @timestamp ASC
